blocks.text:
In this step, we use a `Gtk::Builder` instance to associate a
`Gtk::Builder` ui file with our application window class.
blocks.zh: 再次步骤中，我们使用Gtk::Builder实例将Gtk::Builder UI文件和我们的应用程序窗口类相关联。

blocks.text:
Our simple ui file gives the window a title, and puts a `Gtk::Stack`
widget as the main content.
blocks.zh: 我们的简单UI文件为窗口设定了一个标题，并将一个Gtk::Stack文件放入了窗口中。

blocks.text:
To make use of this file in our application, we revisit our
`Gtk::ApplicationWindow` subclass, and call
Gtk::Builder::create_from_resource() and
Gtk::Builder::get_widget_derived() from the
ExampleAppWindow::create() method to get an instance of
our subclassed `Gtk::ApplicationWindow`. See the
[Using derived widgets]() section
for more information about get_widget_derived().
blocks.zh: 为了在我们的应用程序中使用这个文件，我们重访Gtk::ApplicationWindow子类，并在ExampleAppWindow::create()成员函数中调用Gtk::Builder::create_from_resource()和Gtk::Builder::get_widget_derived()以获取我们的Gtk::ApplicationWindow子类的实例。更多有关的get_widget_derived()的信息，请参见使用派生部件小节。

blocks.text:
You may have noticed that we use the _from_resource() variant
of the method that reads the ui file. Now we need to use `GLib`'s
resource functionality to include the ui file in the binary. This is commonly done by
listing all resources in a .gresource.xml file.
This file has to be converted into a C source file that will be compiled and linked
into the application together with the other source files. To do so, we use the
`glib-compile-resources` utility:
$ glib-compile-resources --target=resources.c --generate-source exampleapp.gresource.xml
The [Gio::Resource and glib-compile-resources]()
section contains more information about resource files. If you build with Meson,
use the `compile_resources()` function in Meson's
[GNOME module](https://mesonbuild.com/Gnome-module.html).
